name: us-form-8832-entity-classification
description: Decide the federal tax classification of an eligible entity and file Form 8832 when the default is not the one the owners want. Covers domestic and foreign default rules, the 75-day retroactive and 12-month prospective window, the 60-month limit on a second change, late relief under Rev. Proc. 2009-41 (3 years and 75 days), and the deemed transactions when a classification changes. A per se corporation cannot elect. A timely S election is not filed on this form. Trigger on "Form 8832", "check the box", "entity classification", "disregarded entity", "eligible entity", "late classification relief". Tax year 2026. Federal only.
